$Comment: Be on the server while Hallow's Eve runs. CALENDAR_ATTENDED fires once per player for each year's
run of the event, when the player is first in the world while it runs, so this is the season's
welcome. The criterion's TextKey words the step, since the shared sentence names the event by its
Rewards.Auto pays what lands the moment it is earned: the title Hallows_Eve_Jacks_Guest (the Title
reward kind), and MMO Skill Tree's Mmo_Boost_Token, a quarter more XP in every skill for half an
hour, which the player starts when it suits them and which is kept with their skills, not in the
bag. The token's own Requires, the hytale:mod_installed gate, leaves that row out on a server
without that mod, unpaid and unshown. Every year's copy names the same title, so a second year
unlocks nothing new; a player who earned the achievement before the title existed gets it at their
Rewards.Claim is favor with Old Jack and with the Hallowed (the Reputation rewards; Amount is how
much), waiting on the achievements page until the player collects it. A copy earned before these
rows existed was settled the moment it was earned, so it never shows them to collect.
